inductance_definition: Preserve the proposed measured open-primary Lp. Decompose Lm=Lp/(1+lambda), Llk=lambda*Lm, lambda=Llk/Lm. The actual multi-winding inductance matrix is not established.
source_conditions: 11W is a normal-operation design/model hypothesis, not a guaranteed fault-input bound. TVS plateaus include inherited cold/hot proxies, not guaranteed dynamic I-V limits. Native100K/W is typical at minimum recommended layout; the required actual assembly limit is an unverified design condition. Vdiode1.7V is a sensitivity, not a full-temperature maximum.
